title: PhaseKeep Research Development — V0–V1.0 Consolidation
description: AI-assisted theoretical and computational research consolidation, checkpoints V0 through V1.0, archived from GitHub commit aaf0f6ce164e22cb8721d6901ad85f2e9fc887eb. This is a development pre-release, not product maturity. No experimental hardware validation, independent scientific reproduction or quantum advantage is claimed. The repository snapshot includes the unchanged Edition 03 Revision H library as a baseline; this DOI identifies the development snapshot, not a separate Revision H release. Text and figures are CC BY 4.0; original code is MIT, subject to NOTICE.txt. Sixteen release assets and their SHA-256 manifest are available at https://github.com/tyses101/phasekeep-research/releases/tag/research-development-v1.0 . Zenodo archives the GitHub source snapshot, not those separately uploaded assets.
